environmentVariables.description: Micetro service-account username. Required in self-hosted mode (MCP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE unset or self-hosted) unless MICETRO_API_KEY is used instead — the server needs exactly one of the two credential options. environmentVariables.name: MICETRO_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Micetro API key (Micetro 26.1 and later). Alternative to MICETRO_USERNAME + MICETRO_PASSWORD; wins over the username/password pair when both are set. Every outbound request carries `authorization: Bearer <key>` and no session login is performed. Unlike MICETRO_USERNAME/MICETRO_PASSWORD, which are simply not used in horizon mode, MICETRO_API_KEY is rejected at startup there — cloud mode has no fixed backend identity for a key to authenticate.
environmentVariables.name: MICETRO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Client authentication mode for the /mcp endpoint. One of: none | static-key | signed-key | resource-server. Required at runtime — the server refuses to start without it (no default).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Static bearer token clients present as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Required only when MCP_AUTH_MODE=static-key.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Ed25519 public key (base64url) that MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key verifies license tokens against. DEFAULTS TO A SHARED DEMO KEY, which authenticates a token holder rather than a customer — every BlueCat-issued token for this server verifies against it. For anything beyond a trial, generate a per-deployment key pair (license-keygen --gen-key) and set this to its public half.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY

environmentVariables.description: When set, a license token must carry exactly this audience or it is rejected — a declarative scope check on top of the key, so a token minted for another deployment fails even if it verifies. Unset means the aud claim is not checked. Only meaningful with MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SIGNED_KEY_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: Token issuer URL, matched against the iss claim of incoming JWTs. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint whose public keys verify the signature on every incoming Bearer JWT. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_JWKS_URI

environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT aud claim for MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server. A token carrying a different audience, or no aud claim at all, is rejected. Unset skips audience validation entirely.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: Set to Y (or Yes/YES, any casing) to accept the BlueCat End User License Agreement. The container refuses to start without it.
